anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy select when the user changes workspaces in the report view?
A) clear all filters - every switch resets the view to unfiltered
B) preserve all active filters - the current filters carry over to the new workspace
C) restore each workspace's last filters - each workspace remembers and reapplies its own filters
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already retains active filters, so B keeps current behavior and needs no new per-workspace filter storage behind settings/resolver.ts:12.
